name: Tachibana Yuina
source:
In the same way that the protagonist lost his mother and decided to become a doctor, she lost her brother and decided on the same goal. However, she was not able to realize that dream... Now, she is seeking it. A person to whom she can entrust her dream. And the power to grant her own dream again.

[Based on the [url=http://www.oaks-soft.co.jp/princess-soft/21twoone/21chara.html]official site[/url]]
